newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria March producer prices rise 36.6 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria March producer prices rise 36.6 pct m/m.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly producer price inflation was 36.6 percent in March against 129.4 a month earlier and 2.4 percent in March 1996, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said on Friday.
BULGARIAN PRODUCER PRICES MARCH FEB MARCH'96
"The slower rise in producer prices last month was mainly a result of the rise in the lev against the dollar," a NSI official, who declined to be named told Reuters.
The stronger lev pared the prices of imported raw materials, on which Bulgaria's economy is strongly dependent, said the official. @
The lev rose to around 1,600 per dollar on the local interbank market at end-March from around 1,800 at the beginning of the month after it nosedived to all-time lows of 3,000-3,200 in February.
The lev traded near 500 to the dollar at the beginning of the year.
